<!DOCTYPE html>

Continue to the website
                    
                
                
                    (function () {
                        var form = document.getElementById('o_auth_telegram_open_form');
                        var wait = document.getElementById('o_auth_telegram_open_wait');
                        var missing = document.getElementById('o_auth_telegram_open_missing');
                        var key = window.location.hash ? window.location.hash.substring(1) : '';
                        // drop the secret from the address bar and the history at once
                        if (window.history) {
                            if (window.history.replaceState) {
                                window.history.replaceState(null, '', window.location.pathname);
                            }
                        }
                        // back button / page restored from the cache: never post again
                        window.addEventListener('pageshow', function (ev) {
                            if (ev.persisted) {
                                wait.hidden = true;
                                missing.hidden = false;
                            }
                        });
                        if (!key) { return; }
                        if (form.getAttribute('data-sent')) { return; }
                        // a single-use secret: post it exactly once (no button to post it twice)
                        form.setAttribute('data-sent', '1');
                        document.getElementById('o_auth_telegram_open_key').value = key;
                        missing.hidden = true;
                        wait.hidden = false;
                        form.submit();
                    })();
